market_summary: All six instruments are exhibiting late New York session consolidation with declining volatility and sub-1.0 RVOL across the board. Precious metals and FX pairs are pinned near session lows and lower ATR boundaries without yellow RVOL expansion spikes to justify continuation breakdowns. US100 is constrained within a positive dampening GEX regime between its primary Call Wall and value area low, while BTCUSD chops in a narrow mean-reverting band directly around its session Point of Control. Due to lack of volume confirmation and mid-range or boundary compression, all setups are placed on HOLD.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 3875.39 to VAH 3899.74) and below POC (3882.58). Volume lacks confirmation with RVOL at 0.845 (grey bars). GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING with Gamma Flip at 4014.33 (price below flip); price is sitting directly atop Put Wall #1 (3877.90) and above S/R support (3872.05) and Session Low (3867.64). Per GEX rules, selling directly into Put Wall #1 without scalp room is prohibited, requiring a HOLD.

RVOL is low at 0.465 with no yellow volume spikes to confirm a fresh breakdown, indicating exhausted stretch into lower ATR bands rather than an actionable expansion. GEX is null. A disciplined HOLD is required.

Volume is muted with RVOL at 0.592 (no yellow spikes). Price is stalled between Prev Low resistance (1.32210) and Session Low support (1.32049) without catalyst or breakout confirmation. GEX is null. The setup warrants a HOLD.

Price trades below VAL (27916.11) and below POC (28269.40). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.30) with a flat slope (-0.22). Price is sandwiched between Call Wall #1 (27891.21) below and Prev Low resistance (27912.13) above, well above Session Low (27608.11). Mean-reverting dampening in a narrow cluster dictates a HOLD.

Price is below VAL (49.469) and below POC (50.007). CVD is BEARISH (-235.8) with negative slope (-5.0), agreeing with the overarching downtrend. However, in late NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trading below VWAP (49.829) and EMA50 (49.440) while hugging the lower ATR band (48.803). Price is tightly compressed between S/R resistance at 48.905 and Session Low support at 48.792. RVOL is low at 0.660 (no yellow bars), making selling into the lower band extreme a trap. GEX is null. A patient HOLD is required.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 68404.25 to VAH 69413.93) and hovering right below session POC magnet (68909.09). CVD is BEARISH (-0.09) with a flat slope (0.0). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, price sits beneath VWAP (69166.74) and EMA50 (69045.28), oscillating right on the EMA20 baseline (68876.41) mid-channel within the ATR envelope. Inside-VA rotation toward fair value warrants a HOLD.
